bug_semantics: OliveTin interpolated attacker-controlled argument values into an action's Shell command and executed the result with sh -c. The password argument type was explicitly accepted without character validation, while checkShellArgumentSafety omitted password from its unsafe-type set, so shell metacharacters in a password escaped the administrator-defined command. Independently, webhook JSON extraction created arbitrary argument-name/value pairs and passed them into ExecutionRequest; names without a corresponding configured ActionArgument skipped type validation yet remained available to shell templating, allowing an unauthenticated webhook value to reach the same sh -c sink.
flaw_origin: The smallest password-vector BIC is PR-head commit d88608c4948b5e44db10f806ac59b93b7d902f17, which first added case "password": return nil to internal/executor/arguments.go and a password input to webui.dev/js/ArgumentForm.js. GitHub squash-landed that one-member change as 943b4c75aa737226e48da4dc04d14899fb16a9d2. The direct member parent eb4f28dfdaad49e0d97dd331269dd47fb2e4d1ac had the pre-existing shell interpolation/execution path but no password special case or password UI type. A later independent origin, f22b3953b1a744fb544f27a9077d79fdb80eb242, introduced webhook extraction and forwarded the resulting unfiltered map into ExecutionRequest; its parent efa964406abec65c1707c075d7cc88b8c2a9abc8 had no service/internal/webhooks/handler.go at all.
ai_marker: absent: the exact BIC commit object for d88608c4948b5e44db10f806ac59b93b7d902f17 records author and committer jamesread <contact@jread.com>, subject "feature: Password type (no validation)", no commit-message trailers, no Co-Authored-By or Generated-with marker, and no bot identity.
evidence: First-party advisory: https://github.com/OliveTin/OliveTin/security/advisories/GHSA-49gm-hh7w-wfvf identifies CVE-2026-27626, the password bypass at service/internal/executor/arguments.go:198-199 and :313, the webhook path at service/internal/webhooks/handler.go:153-157, and the sh -c sink at service/internal/executor/executor_unix.go:18; it reports affected versions <= 3000.10.0 and patched version 3000.10.1. The advisory's first-party fix link is https://github.com/OliveTin/OliveTin/commit/4bbd2eab153287dc744ad061c58af7693f0c3ddc. History search `git log -S'case "password"'` and `git log -L` found the first password/no-validation addition at squash landing 943b4c75aa737226e48da4dc04d14899fb16a9d2 (https://github.com/OliveTin/OliveTin/commit/943b4c75aa737226e48da4dc04d14899fb16a9d2). First-party PR https://github.com/OliveTin/OliveTin/pull/340 has head d88608c4948b5e44db10f806ac59b93b7d902f17; `git log fb972fae556f9849ba1b07e6a0da99d1b68e7354..d88608c4948b5e44db10f806ac59b93b7d902f17` showed exactly one PR member, and stable patch-id for d88608c4948b5e44db10f806ac59b93b7d902f17 and 943b4c75aa737226e48da4dc04d14899fb16a9d2 was identically 255b5d30af7235f328ed3401d8f41b913b2484c6. `git diff eb4f28dfdaad49e0d97dd331269dd47fb2e4d1ac d88608c4948b5e44db10f806ac59b93b7d902f17` shows the BIC adding `case "password": return nil` in internal/executor/arguments.go and the password input in webui.dev/js/ArgumentForm.js; direct-parent `git show eb4f28dfdaad49e0d97dd331269dd47fb2e4d1ac:internal/executor/arguments.go` shows only url/datetime special cases and therefore proves the vulnerable password lines absent. The pre-existing parent execution path parsed req.Action.Shell with req.Arguments and passed req.finalParsedCommand to exec.CommandContext(ctx, "sh", "-c", ...). Blame at fix parent 1db6509288bb356c6b9128a2318c91fc16e80d83 traces the surviving password return-nil lines to the later refactor and the shell unsafe set to c917d1b1e7a2a90acec79760cb1ff18ffae82409/c3d5da198119a86df7f37601f911a5b445016ca3, whose set still omitted password; these are continuations/refactors, not the first origin. For the second vector, `git diff efa964406abec65c1707c075d7cc88b8c2a9abc8 f22b3953b1a744fb544f27a9077d79fdb80eb242` shows new service/internal/webhooks/matcher.go ExtractArguments accepting configured JSONPath values and new service/internal/webhooks/handler.go assigning the unfiltered map directly to ExecutionRequest.Arguments. The direct fix diff adds password to checkShellArgumentSafety, filters arguments to configured names in service/internal/webhooks/handler.go and service/internal/executor/executor.go, and rejects webhook-tagged Shell execution. `git tag --contains 943b4c75aa737226e48da4dc04d14899fb16a9d2` begins with 2024.07.03 and includes 3000.10.0; `git tag --contains f22b3953b1a744fb544f27a9077d79fdb80eb242` begins with 3000.9.0-beta.1 and includes 3000.10.0. `git tag --contains 4bbd2eab153287dc744ad061c58af7693f0c3ddc` begins with 3000.10.1 and excludes 3000.10.0, and the 3000.10.0..3000.10.1 source diff contains the complete fix. The Go advisory boundary in the assigned first-party advisory data is < 0.0.0-20260222101908-4bbd2eab1532 with first patched pseudo-version 0.0.0-20260222101908-4bbd2eab1532, matching the fix commit timestamp and prefix. Finally, `git cat-file -p d88608c4948b5e44db10f806ac59b93b7d902f17` is the sole AI-attribution inspection and contains only human jamesread author/committer identities and the subject, with no AI trailer or bot marker.
reasoning: The advisory describes two paths to the same shell-command-injection sink. For the password path, the causal addition is not the 2025 safety-map refactor or the 2026 fix: the flaw became available when the password type was deliberately introduced with no validation while Shell interpolation and sh -c execution already existed. The public landing commit 943b4c75aa737226e48da4dc04d14899fb16a9d2 is a squash, so PR ref 340 was decomposed. It has one member, d88608c4948b5e44db10f806ac59b93b7d902f17, with the same stable patch-id; that member is therefore the smallest BIC. Its immediate parent eb4f28dfdaad49e0d97dd331269dd47fb2e4d1ac lacks both password additions, satisfying direct-parent absence. The later shell-safety code failed to remove the already-existing flaw by omitting password. The webhook vector was independently introduced by f22b3953b1a744fb544f27a9077d79fdb80eb242 when it created unfiltered extracted arguments and forwarded them to the executor; it entered released history by 3000.9.0-beta.1. Fix 4bbd2eab153287dc744ad061c58af7693f0c3ddc closes both paths, and repository tag ancestry/source diffs agree with the first-party 3000.10.0 affected and 3000.10.1 fixed boundary. The exact decomposed BIC object has no commit-object AI signal, so under the BIC-only attribution rule the closed verdict is NOT_AI.
